title: Aromatic Spicy Japanese Peas Ramen
description: A pescatarian-friendly, spicy, and chewy Japanese dish featuring split peas, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the broth, soy sauce, sugar, grated ginger, and garlic, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has reduced slightly and the flavors have melded together.
While the broth is simmering, cook the noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large saucepan, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat and sauté the split peas for 2-3 minutes, or until they are lightly browned.
Add the green chili peppers to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until they are tender.
Add the cooked noodles to the saucepan and stir to combine with the split peas and chili peppers.
Pour the simmered broth over the noodles and split peas, and stir to combine.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds, scallions, and additional chili peppers if desired.
Serve hot, with a side of your favorite toppings, such as sliced green onions, grated ginger, or sesame seeds.
